# German–English glossary {#sec-glossary}

Useful if you read the German books or meet these terms in German-speaking companies.

| German | English |
|------------------------------|-------------------------------------------|
| Bruchrechnung | Fractions |
| Zähler, Nenner | Numerator, denominator |
| Kürzen, Erweitern | Simplifying, expanding (a fraction) |
| Prozentsatz, Grundwert, Prozentwert | Rate, base, part (percentage value) |
| Mehrwertsteuer (Umsatzsteuer), netto, brutto | VAT, net, gross |
| Aufschlag, Handelsspanne | Markup, margin |
| Prozentpunkt | Percentage point |
| Potenz, Basis, Exponent, Wurzel | Power, base, exponent, root |
| Binomische Formeln | Binomial formulas |
| Ausmultiplizieren, Ausklammern | Multiplying out, factoring out |
| Milliarde | Billion ($10^9$) |
| Gleichung, Ungleichung | Equation, inequality |
| Funktion, Steigung, Achsenabschnitt | Function, slope, intercept |
| Kosten, Erlös (Umsatz), Gewinn | Cost, revenue, profit |
| Gewinnschwelle | Break-even point |
| Zins, Zinseszins | Interest, compound interest |
| Barwert, Endwert | Present value, future value |
| Abschreibung (linear, degressiv) | Depreciation (straight-line, declining-balance) |
| Annuität, Tilgung, Restschuld | Annuity (instalment), repayment, outstanding balance |
